publicGates.command: node bin/note.js add --title Test --body Body | node -e "let data=''; process.stdin.on('data',c=>data+=c); process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const parsed=JSON.parse(data); if(parsed.title!=='Test'||parsed.body!=='Body') throw new Error(data);});"

hiddenGates.command: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['bin/note.js','add','--body','Body'], { encoding:'utf8' }); if (r.status === 0 || !/title/i.test(r.stderr)) throw new Error('expected title error');"
